title: Specsavers — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 98bpm brushed drums gentle comedy self-deprecating English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
It was Corey's birthday morning, twenty-three photos sent
Wilma's finest album, every angle that she meant
Twenty faces, twenty smiles, lined up wall to wall
Then she noticed something — bottom three weren't Corey at all

[Verse 2 — Español]
Dios mío dijo — esos tres de abajo no son Corey [Oh dear she said — those bottom three aren't Corey]
Son Pete, son Pete, definitivamente Pete, qué historia [They're Pete, they're Pete, definitely Pete, what a story]
Lo siento dijo Mum en el grupo por lo que pasó [Lo siento said Mum in the group for what occurred]
Parece que voy a Specsavers — eso es lo que la situación me enseñó [Seems I need Specsavers — that's what this situation taught me]

[Chorus — English]
Happy birthday Corey, sorry about the mix
Bottom three were Pete, dear — isn't that a fix
Gotta go to Specsavers, haha, love you all
The gardens still growing, even when I drop the ball

[Bridge — Français]
Joyeux anniversaire Corey, désolée pour la confusion [Happy birthday Corey, sorry for the confusion]
Les trois dernières photos — c'était Pete ma chérie [The bottom three photos — that was Pete my dear]
Il faut que j'aille chez Specsavers, haha, je vous aime [I need to go to Specsavers, haha, I love you all]
Le jardin pousse encore, même quand je me trompe [The garden is still growing, even when I make mistakes]

[Verse 3 — English]
Pete didn't mind, he liked being in the album
Corey laughed so hard the phone fell off the bench
Mum just said — well at least I sent twenty
It's the thought that counts, that's her defence

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The gardens still growing
El jardín sigue creciendo [The garden is still growing]
Le jardin pousse encore [The garden is still growing]
Gotta go to Specsavers
